migrations.legacy_claim: P(Omega)=1 implies a physically closed system
migrations.replacement: Normalization means total probability on the declared outcome domain is 1; openness is represented through dynamics, boundary flow, environment coupling, memory, or partial observation.
Use finite nonnegative measure/intensity mu with total mass mu(X)>1; normalized probability is P=mu/mu(X).

migrations.legacy_claim: P<0 is negative event probability / probability erasure
migrations.replacement: Use signed measure or quasiprobability, and do not call it ordinary probability.
Dynamic judgment domain D_t=(X_t,Sigma_t;r_t,s_t,c_t) with time transport K_{s,t} and event/judgment translations.
Source/sink changes total mass M_t; normalized conditional law P_t may remain a probability measure.

migrations.legacy_claim: relation measures require rejection of ordinary measure theory
migrations.replacement: Relations can be encoded in the judgment domain, graph/path spaces, random measures, signed/complex measures, or other established measure constructions.
